About the Research Poster event

Research Poster is a Teamwork event in the HOSA secondary division. Format: speech & presentation · online submission.

Ten in-depth lessons for the HOSA Research Poster team event (2–4 secondary or postsecondary members, new to the Teamwork category in 2026–27), following the guidelines and rating sheets: choosing a local, health-related research question, background research, research design and methods, ethics and informed consent, analyzing quantitative and qualitative data, writing each poster section, designing a 48″ × 36″ landscape poster, uploading, printing and the required display time, and the five-minute Round Two presentation. Includes FINER, sampling, bias, statistics and design drills and practice scenarios.
